# Eternalgy Lead API

> Create leads with source attribution and optional sales-agent assignment; discover source accounts and agents; retrieve current leads by Introducer.

- [Human documentation](https://referral.atap.solar/api-docs): Full API reference and integration examples.
- [AI agent guide](https://referral.atap.solar/api-docs/agent-guide): Plain Markdown, terminology, request rules, pagination, errors and safe retries, with a runnable read-only Node.js example.
- [OpenAPI 3.1 JSON](https://referral.atap.solar/api-docs/openapi.json): Machine-readable operation, authentication, request and response schemas.

Base URL: https://referral.atap.solar
Business term Introducer maps to the API field/query parameter referrer.
All business endpoints require Authorization: Bearer <LEADS_API_KEY> from your backend. Documentation is public.
POST /api/leads creates a real lead and is not idempotent. Do not replay it automatically after an uncertain result.
GET /api/leads lists source-account leads with limit/offset pagination; person referrals are excluded.
Use documentation from the same deployed server as the API.
